models.name: shopping_mall_channels
models.description: Sales channels through which customers access the platform. Represents different access points such as web storefront, mobile application, API marketplace, or partner integrations. Each channel may have distinct configurations, sections, and operational parameters. Referenced by {@link shopping_mall_sections} for channel-specific content organization.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique business identifier for the channel. Examples: WEB, MOBILE_APP, API, PARTNER_PORTAL. Used for programmatic channel reference.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable display name of the channel. Examples: Web Storefront, Mobile Application, API Marketplace.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the channel purpose and characteristics. Explains how customers access the platform through this channel.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether this channel is currently operational and accepting traffic. Inactive channels are hidden from customer access but configuration is preserved.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this channel was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this channel configuration was last modified.

models.name: shopping_mall_sections
models.description: Organizational sections within platform channels for grouping products, content, or features. Examples include category sections like Electronics, Fashion, Home & Garden, or functional sections like Featured Products, New Arrivals, Best Sellers. Each section belongs to a specific channel. Referenced by product categorization and content organization systems.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Channel to which this section belongs. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique business identifier for the section within its channel. Examples: ELECTRONICS, FASHION, HOME_GARDEN. Used for programmatic section reference.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable display name of the section. Examples: Electronics, Fashion & Apparel, Home & Garden.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the section purpose and what content or products it contains. Helps admins understand section organization.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Numeric value controlling the display sequence of sections within a channel. Lower numbers appear first. Allows admins to control section ordering in navigation menus.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether this section is currently visible to users. Inactive sections are hidden but configuration is preserved for future reactivation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this section was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this section configuration was last modified.

models.name: shopping_mall_system_configurations
models.description: Platform-wide system settings and configuration parameters stored as key-value pairs. Examples include platform commission rates, feature toggles, checkout settings, tax calculation rules, email service settings, payment gateway configurations. Allows admins to control platform behavior without code deployment. Each configuration has a unique key for programmatic access.

plainFields.name: config_key
plainFields.description: Unique configuration key identifier. Examples: platform.commission_rate, checkout.guest_enabled, email.smtp_host, payment.gateway_mode. Uses dot notation for hierarchical organization.

plainFields.name: config_value
plainFields.description: Configuration value stored as string. Can contain simple values, numbers as strings, or JSON-encoded complex values. Application layer parses based on data_type field.

plainFields.name: data_type
plainFields.description: Data type indicator for parsing config_value. Valid values: string, number, boolean, json. Helps application layer correctly interpret and validate configuration values.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description of what this configuration parameter controls. Provides guidance to admins when modifying settings.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration value was last modified. Important for tracking configuration changes and troubleshooting.

models.name: shopping_mall_announcements
models.description: Platform-wide announcements and notices displayed to users. Examples include maintenance notifications, promotional campaign announcements, policy updates, special events. Announcements can target specific audiences (all users, customers only, sellers only, admins only), belong to specific channels, and have scheduled publication periods. Supports content lifecycle with draft, published, and archived statuses.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Channel where this announcement is displayed. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}. Null indicates announcement is shown across all channels.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Announcement headline or title. Displayed prominently to attract user attention. Should be concise and descriptive.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Complete announcement content. Supports rich text or HTML formatting for detailed information, links, and formatting. Contains the full message to be communicated to users.

plainFields.name: target_audience
plainFields.description: Intended audience for this announcement. Valid values: all, customers, sellers, admins. Determines who can see this announcement in the platform.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Announcement importance level affecting display prominence. Valid values: normal, important, urgent. Higher priority announcements are displayed more prominently.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Publication workflow status. Valid values: draft, published, archived. Draft announcements are not visible to users, published are active, archived are historical.

plainFields.name: publish_start_at
plainFields.description: Scheduled start date and time for displaying this announcement. Announcement becomes visible to users at or after this timestamp if status is published.

plainFields.name: publish_end_at
plainFields.description: Scheduled end date and time for displaying this announcement. Announcement is automatically hidden after this timestamp. Null means no end date and announcement remains visible until manually archived.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this announcement was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this announcement was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, announcement is marked as deleted but data is preserved for audit trail. Supports announcement lifecycle management.

models.name: shopping_mall_static_pages
models.description: CMS-managed static content pages for platform information and policies. Examples include About Us, Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, FAQ, Help Center, Contact Us, Shipping Policy, Return Policy. Each page has a unique URL slug and supports draft/published workflow for content management. Supports SEO optimization with meta descriptions.

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly unique identifier for the page. Examples: about-us, privacy-policy, terms-of-service, faq, contact-us. Used in page URLs like /pages/about-us.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Page title displayed as heading and in browser title bar. Examples: About Us, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Frequently Asked Questions.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Complete page content. Supports rich text or HTML formatting for complex layouts, headings, lists, links, and embedded media. Contains the full page content displayed to users.

plainFields.name: meta_description
plainFields.description: SEO meta description for search engine results. Brief summary of page content (150-160 characters recommended) displayed in search engine snippets.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Publication workflow status. Valid values: draft, published. Draft pages are not publicly accessible, published pages are visible to all users. Supports content review workflow.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Numeric value controlling the display order in footer menus or navigation. Lower numbers appear first. Allows admins to control page ordering in site navigation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this page was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this page content was last modified. Important for tracking content freshness and editorial changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, page is marked as deleted but content is preserved for audit trail. Supports page lifecycle management and content archival.

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description: Customer accounts representing registered buyers who browse products, make purchases, and manage their orders. Customers authenticate with email and password, maintain delivery addresses, shopping carts, wishlists, and order history. Each customer can have multiple orders and addresses but requires separate accounts if they also want to be sellers.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer email address used for authentication and communications. Must be unique across all customer accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for customer authentication. Never stored in plain text, always hashed using secure one-way hashing algorithm (bcrypt).

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Customer full name for personalization and order shipping purposes.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Customer phone number for order delivery coordination and account recovery.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the customer has verified their email address through verification link. Required before full account access is granted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was soft deleted. NULL indicates active account. Used for account suspension and deletion with data retention.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description: Customer authentication sessions for JWT-based session management and audit trail. Each session represents a customer login instance with connection context (IP, referrer). Sessions expire after defined timeout or explicit logout.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this authentication session. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the customer session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating how the customer arrived at the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created (login time).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires or was terminated. NULL indicates active session.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description: Seller accounts representing vendors who operate storefronts within the marketplace. Sellers authenticate with business email and password, manage product catalogs, process orders, and track sales performance. Each seller undergoes verification before being allowed to list products.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller business email address used for authentication and business communications. Must be unique across all seller accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for seller authentication. Never stored in plain text, always hashed using secure one-way hashing algorithm (bcrypt).

plainFields.name: business_name
plainFields.description: Official business or store name displayed to customers.

plainFields.name: business_registration_number
plainFields.description: Business registration or tax identification number for verification and compliance purposes.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Business phone number for customer service and platform communications.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the seller has verified their business email address through verification link.

plainFields.name: verified
plainFields.description: Whether the seller account has been verified and approved by platform administrators. Sellers cannot list products until verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was registered.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account information was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was soft deleted or suspended. NULL indicates active account.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description: Seller authentication sessions for JWT-based session management and audit trail. Each session represents a seller login instance with connection context (IP, referrer). Sessions expire after defined timeout or explicit logout.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who owns this authentication session. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the seller session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating how the seller arrived at the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created (login time).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires or was terminated. NULL indicates active session.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description: Administrator accounts with elevated permissions to manage the entire marketplace ecosystem. Admins oversee users, orders, products, reviews, disputes, and system configuration. Admin accounts are created only by existing admins, never through public registration.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator email address used for authentication and admin communications. Must be unique across all admin accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for admin authentication. Never stored in plain text, always hashed using secure one-way hashing algorithm (bcrypt).

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Administrator full name for identification in audit logs and admin panel.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the admin has verified their email address. Required before full admin access is granted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was soft deleted or deactivated. NULL indicates active account.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description: Administrator authentication sessions for JWT-based session management and audit trail. Each session represents an admin login instance with connection context (IP, referrer). Admin sessions have shorter expiration for enhanced security.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who owns this authentication session. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the admin session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating how the admin arrived at the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created (login time).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires or was terminated. NULL indicates active session.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_addresses
models.description: Delivery addresses saved by customers for order shipping. Each customer can maintain multiple addresses with one marked as default. Addresses store recipient information, full address details, and are used during checkout for order fulfillment.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this delivery address. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Full name of the person who will receive deliveries at this address.

plainFields.name: recipient_phone
plainFields.description: Phone number for delivery coordination and contact.

plainFields.name: address_line_1
plainFields.description: Primary street address or building information.

plainFields.name: address_line_2
plainFields.description: Secondary address information such as apartment number, suite, or unit number.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City or locality name for the delivery address.

plainFields.name: state_province
plainFields.description: State, province, or region name for the delivery address.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal code or ZIP code for the delivery address.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country name or code for the delivery address.

plainFields.name: address_label
plainFields.description: Optional label for the address such as Home, Office, or Warehouse for easy identification.

plainFields.name: is_default
plainFields.description: Whether this is the customer's default delivery address. Used to pre-select address during checkout. Only one address per customer should have this set to true.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the address was added to customer's address book.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the address information was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the address was deleted from customer's address book. NULL indicates active address. Deleted addresses are retained for historical order records.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_categories
models.description: Product category taxonomy supporting hierarchical organization of products. Categories can have parent categories to create multi-level hierarchies (e.g., Electronics > Computers > Laptops). Each category has unique identification, display information, and position in the category tree. Categories enable customers to browse products by classification and support faceted navigation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Channel to which this category belongs. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent category for hierarchical taxonomy. {@link shopping_mall_product_categories.id}. Null for top-level categories.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category name displayed to users (e.g., Electronics, Fashion, Home & Garden).

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly category identifier for SEO and routing (e.g., electronics, fashion-apparel).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Category description explaining the types of products in this category.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Display order for sorting categories at the same hierarchy level. Lower numbers appear first.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Category status: active (visible to customers), inactive (hidden but preserved).

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: Category icon or banner image URL for visual display.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Non-null when category is deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description: Core product entity representing sellable items in the marketplace. Each product is owned by a seller and belongs to a category. Products contain descriptive information and can have multiple variants (SKUs) with different attributes. Products serve as the foundation for the catalog, with SKUs representing the actual purchasable inventory units.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Channel where this product is listed. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who owns and manages this product. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_category_id
foreignFields.description: Primary category classification for this product. {@link shopping_mall_product_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name or title displayed to customers (3-200 characters).

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly product identifier for SEO and routing.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description with rich text content (minimum 20 characters).

plainFields.name: brand
plainFields.description: Product brand name or manufacturer.

plainFields.name: model_number
plainFields.description: Manufacturer model number or part number for product identification.

plainFields.name: condition
plainFields.description: Product condition: new, refurbished, or used.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Product lifecycle status: draft (not visible), active (published), inactive (hidden), archived (permanently removed from catalog).

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base selling price before variant adjustments or discounts. Must be positive.

plainFields.name: weight
plainFields.description: Product weight in kilograms for shipping calculations.

plainFields.name: dimensions
plainFields.description: Product dimensions in format length×width×height (e.g., 10×8×5 cm).

plainFields.name: meta_title
plainFields.description: SEO meta title for search engine optimization.

plainFields.name: meta_description
plainFields.description: SEO meta description for search engine results.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Non-null when product is deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshots
models.description: Historical snapshots of product data preserving point-in-time product state for audit trails and order records. When product information changes (price, description, specifications), snapshots maintain the exact product details as they were when customers placed orders. This ensures order history accuracy and supports regulatory compliance.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product for which this snapshot was created. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who owned the product at snapshot time. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category the product belonged to at snapshot time. {@link shopping_mall_product_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Product description at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: brand
plainFields.description: Product brand at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: model_number
plainFields.description: Model number at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: condition
plainFields.description: Product condition at snapshot time: new, refurbished, or used.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: weight
plainFields.description: Product weight at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: dimensions
plainFields.description: Product dimensions at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_options
models.description: Product variant option types that define how products can vary (e.g., Color, Size, Material, Style). Each option type can be reused across multiple products. Options have values that represent specific choices customers can select. This enables the product variant system where products can have multiple SKUs based on option combinations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Channel where this option is defined. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Option type name (e.g., Color, Size, Material, Capacity, Style).

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Display order for presenting options to customers. Lower numbers appear first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the option type was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the option type was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Non-null when option type is deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_option_values
models.description: Specific values for product option types (e.g., Red/Blue/Green for Color option, S/M/L/XL for Size option). Each value belongs to an option type and can be assigned to product SKUs. Option values enable customers to select specific product variants and help generate unique SKU combinations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_option_id
foreignFields.description: Option type to which this value belongs. {@link shopping_mall_product_options.id}.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Specific option value (e.g., Red, Medium, Cotton, 64GB).

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Display order for presenting values within the option type. Lower numbers appear first.

plainFields.name: color_hex
plainFields.description: Hexadecimal color code for color swatches (applicable only for Color option types).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the option value was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the option value was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Non-null when option value is deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_skus
models.description: Individual Stock Keeping Units representing unique purchasable product variants. Each SKU represents a specific combination of product options (e.g., T-Shirt in Red color, Medium size). SKUs have unique identifiers, individual pricing, and independent inventory tracking. Customers purchase specific SKUs, not generic products.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product to which this SKU belongs. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique SKU identifier code for inventory tracking and order fulfillment (e.g., TSHIRT-RED-M-001).

plainFields.name: variant_name
plainFields.description: Human-readable variant description combining all option values (e.g., Red / Medium, 64GB / Black).

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: SKU-specific selling price. If null, inherits product base_price. Must be positive when set.

plainFields.name: compare_at_price
plainFields.description: Original price before discount for showing savings to customers.

plainFields.name: cost_per_item
plainFields.description: Seller's cost for this SKU for profit margin calculation. Not visible to customers.

plainFields.name: barcode
plainFields.description: UPC, EAN, ISBN, or other barcode identifier for the SKU.

plainFields.name: weight
plainFields.description: SKU-specific weight in kilograms. If null, inherits product weight.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: SKU availability status: active (purchasable), inactive (hidden), discontinued (no longer sold).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the SKU was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the SKU was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Non-null when SKU is deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description: Product media assets including photos and visual content. Each product can have multiple images displayed in galleries. Images can be associated with the overall product or specific SKU variants. Primary images are featured in listings and search results, while additional images provide detailed product views.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product to which this image belongs. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Specific SKU variant this image represents. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}. Null for general product images.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL or path to the product image file.

plainFields.name: alt_text
plainFields.description: Alternative text description for accessibility and SEO.

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: Whether this is the primary/featured image displayed in product listings and search results.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Display order for image gallery sequence. Lower numbers appear first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was uploaded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Non-null when image is deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_tags
models.description: Product tags and keywords for enhanced searchability and product discovery. Tags are shared across products and enable customers to find related products through tag-based browsing. Common tags include materials, features, occasions, or themes (e.g., organic, waterproof, wedding, vintage).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Channel where this tag is used. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Tag name or keyword (e.g., organic, waterproof, handmade, eco-friendly).

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly tag identifier for tag-based browsing pages.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Tag description explaining what products with this tag represent.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the tag was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the tag was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Non-null when tag is deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_tag_relations
models.description: Many-to-many junction table connecting products to tags. Each product can have multiple tags, and each tag can be applied to multiple products. This enables flexible product classification beyond hierarchical categories and supports tag-based product discovery and filtering.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product being tagged. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_tag_id
foreignFields.description: Tag being applied to the product. {@link shopping_mall_product_tags.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the tag was applied to the product.

models.name: shopping_mall_shopping_carts
models.description: Shopping cart entity storing temporary product collections before checkout. Supports both authenticated customer carts (persisted across sessions for 90 days) and guest carts (session-based, retained for 7 days). Carts maintain items from multiple sellers for unified checkout experience. Related entities: {@link shopping_mall_shopping_cart_items} for cart contents, {@link shopping_mall_customers} for authenticated cart ownership.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this cart. Nullable to support guest carts identified by session_id. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: session_id
plainFields.description: Session identifier for guest cart tracking. Used when shopping_mall_customer_id is null. Enables cart persistence across guest browsing sessions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was created. Used for cart expiration and cleanup policies.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was last modified. Updated when items are added, removed, or quantities changed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for cart cleanup. Guest carts deleted after 7 days, authenticated carts after 90 days of inactivity.

models.name: shopping_mall_shopping_cart_items
models.description: Individual items within shopping carts. Each cart item references a specific product SKU with quantity selection. Supports multi-seller carts where items from different sellers coexist. Cart items are managed exclusively through cart operations and removed when cart is cleared or order is placed. Related entities: {@link shopping_mall_shopping_carts} for parent cart, {@link shopping_mall_product_skus} for product variant.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shopping_cart_id

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description: Customer wishlist for saving products for future purchase. Each authenticated customer has exactly one wishlist that persists indefinitely across sessions. foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this wishlist. Not nullable as wishlists require authentication. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when wishlist was last modified. Updated when items are added or removed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for wishlist cleanup. Used when customer account is deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description: Individual products saved in customer wishlists. Each item references the product (not specific SKU) as customers may want different variants when purchasing. foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: Parent wishlist containing this item. {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product saved to wishlist. References product level (not SKU) as customers select variants when adding to cart. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when product was added to wishlist. Used for sorting wishlist items (most recent first).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when wishlist item was last modified. Tracks any updates to the wishlist entry.

models.name: shopping_mall_recently_viewed_products
models.description: Tracking of recently viewed products for recommendation and discovery features. Maintains last 20 products viewed per customer or guest session. Used for personalized recommendations and Recently Viewed sections. Automatically cleaned up when exceeding 20 items per customer/session. Supports both authenticated customers and guest tracking. Related entities: {@link shopping_mall_customers} for authenticated tracking, {@link shopping_mall_products} for viewed product.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who viewed the product. Nullable for guest user tracking via session_id. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that was viewed by the customer or guest. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

plainFields.name: session_id
plainFields.description: Session identifier for guest user tracking. Used when shopping_mall_customer_id is null to track guest browsing history.

plainFields.name: viewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was viewed. Used for sorting (most recent first) and enforcing 20-item limit per customer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp. Typically same as viewed_at for new entries.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp. Updated if same product is viewed again to bump it to top of list.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description: Customer orders representing completed purchases. Each order contains items from one or more sellers, delivery information, and payment details. foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed this order. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_session_id
foreignFields.description: Customer session when order was placed for audit trail. {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_address_id
foreignFields.description: Delivery address for this order. {@link shopping_mall_customer_addresses.id}

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique order number displayed to customers for reference and tracking. Format: ORD-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current order status tracking fulfillment lifecycle. Values: pending, payment_confirmed, processing, shipped, in_transit, out_for_delivery, delivered, completed, cancelled, refunded, partially_refunded.

plainFields.name: payment_status
plainFields.description: Payment processing status. Values: pending, completed, failed, refunded, partially_refunded.

plainFields.name: subtotal
plainFields.description: Sum of all order item prices before shipping, taxes, and discounts.

plainFields.name: shipping_cost
plainFields.description: Total shipping cost for this order across all sellers.

plainFields.name: tax_amount
plainFields.description: Tax amount calculated based on delivery address jurisdiction.

plainFields.name: discount_amount
plainFields.description: Total discount amount from promotional codes or campaigns.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Final order total: subtotal + shipping_cost + tax_amount - discount_amount.

plainFields.name: shipping_method
plainFields.description: Shipping method selected by customer. Values: standard, express, overnight, same_day.

plainFields.name: payment_method
plainFields.description: Payment method used for this order. Values: credit_card, debit_card, paypal, apple_pay, google_pay, bank_transfer.

plainFields.name: customer_notes

plainFields.name: payment_confirmed_at

plainFields.name: processing_started_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller marked order as processing and began fulfillment. Tracks seller response time to new orders.

plainFields.name: shipped_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when order was marked as shipped with tracking information. Indicates fulfillment completion by seller.

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when carrier confirmed successful delivery to customer. Completes the order fulfillment lifecycle.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when order was placed by customer.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when order was last modified.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description: Individual line items within an order representing specific products purchased. foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Product SKU variant purchased. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id

plainFields.name: product_name

plainFields.name: variant_details
plainFields.description: Product variant information at time of purchase (color, size, etc.), preserved as JSON or text.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of this item ordered.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Price per unit at time of purchase, preserved for historical accuracy.

plainFields.name: subtotal
plainFields.description: Line item subtotal: quantity × unit_price.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when order item was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_snapshots
models.description: Historical snapshot of complete order state at time of placement. Captures all order details, items, pricing, and product information as they existed at purchase time. foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order this snapshot preserves. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

plainFields.name: order_code

plainFields.description: Complete delivery address at time of order, stored as formatted text or JSON.

plainFields.name: billing_address
plainFields.description: Complete billing address at time of order, stored as formatted text or JSON.

plainFields.name: subtotal

plainFields.description: Discount amount at time of purchase.

plainFields.description: Payment method used at time of purchase.

plainFields.description: Shipping method selected at time of purchase.

plainFields.description: Timestamp when snapshot was created (order placement time).

models.name: shopping_mall_shipping_trackings
models.description: Shipping and delivery tracking information for orders. Records carrier details, tracking numbers, shipment dates, and delivery status. foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller responsible for this shipment portion. Required for multi-seller order tracking. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description: Shipping carrier company name (FedEx, UPS, USPS, DHL, etc.).

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Carrier tracking number for shipment lookup.

plainFields.name: tracking_url
plainFields.description: Direct URL to carrier tracking page for this shipment.

plainFields.name: ship_date
plainFields.description: Date when package was handed to carrier.

plainFields.name: estimated_delivery_date
plainFields.description: Estimated delivery date based on carrier and shipping method.

plainFields.name: actual_delivery_date
plainFields.description: Actual delivery timestamp when package was delivered.

plainFields.name: shipping_status
plainFields.description: Current shipping status. Values: in_transit, out_for_delivery, delivered, delivery_failed, returned_to_sender.

plainFields.name: package_count
plainFields.description: Number of packages in this shipment for multi-package orders.

plainFields.description: Timestamp when tracking information was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellations
models.description: Order cancellation main entity capturing when and why orders were cancelled. Cancellations can be initiated by customers, sellers, or admins through polymorphic actor pattern. foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order that was cancelled. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

plainFields.description: Type of actor who initiated cancellation. Values: customer, seller, admin. Indicates which subtype table contains actor-specific details.

plainFields.description: Timestamp when cancellation was initiated.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_returns
models.description: Customer return requests for delivered orders. foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order for which return is requested. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

foreignFields.description: Customer requesting the return. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller responsible for processing this return request. Added for direct seller access and query optimization. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

foreignFields.description: Admin who approved this return request if admin approval was required. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}

foreignFields.name: rejected_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who rejected this return request if admin rejection occurred. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}

plainFields.name: return_reason

plainFields.name: return_shipping_carrier

plainFields.name: refund_amount

plainFields.name: approved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when return request was approved by seller or admin.

plainFields.name: rejected_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when return request was rejected by seller or admin.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when return request was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_return_items

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_return_id

plainFields.name: item_condition
plainFields.description: Condition of returned item as reported by customer or inspected by seller. Values: unopened, opened_unused, used, damaged, defective.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when return item was added to return request.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellation_of_customers
models.description: Customer-initiated order cancellation subtype entity. Links cancellations to customer actor with session context for complete audit trail. Customers can cancel orders before shipment through customer account interface.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellation_id
foreignFields.description: Main cancellation entity this customer cancellation belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_order_cancellations.id}

models.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellation_of_sellers
models.description: Seller-initiated order cancellation subtype entity. Links cancellations to seller actor with session context for complete audit trail. Sellers cancel orders when unable to fulfill due to inventory issues or other business reasons.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellation_id

models.name: shopping_mall_sku_inventories
models.description: Current inventory state for each product SKU tracking stock quantities, reservations, and availability status. foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Product SKU being tracked. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Total physical stock quantity available in warehouse or store. Updated by seller manual adjustments and system order processing.

plainFields.name: reserved_quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity currently reserved by customers in active checkout sessions. Prevents overselling during concurrent purchases. Auto-released when reservations expire.

plainFields.name: available_quantity

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_reservations
models.description: Temporary inventory reservations during customer checkout process to prevent overselling. Reserves specific quantities for limited time (15-30 minutes) while customer completes payment. Automatically expires and releases inventory if checkout not completed. foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity reserved for this checkout session. Must not exceed available inventory at reservation time.

plainFields.name: reservation_type
plainFields.description: Type of reservation: soft (added to cart, low priority) or hard (in checkout, guaranteed hold). Hard reservations prevent other purchases. Valid values: soft, hard.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for this reservation. Typically 30 minutes for soft reservations, 15 minutes for hard checkout reservations. System auto-releases inventory when this time passes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when reservation was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_movements
models.description: Complete audit trail of all inventory quantity changes with reason tracking and actor identification. plainFields.name: movement_type
plainFields.description: Type of inventory movement: manual_increase (seller restock), manual_decrease (seller adjustment), order_deduction (order placed), reservation_created (checkout hold), reservation_released (abandoned cart), reservation_converted (order confirmed), return_credit (item returned), bulk_update (CSV import), admin_adjustment (admin correction).

plainFields.name: quantity_change
plainFields.description: Quantity change amount. Positive for stock increases (restocks, returns), negative for decreases (sales, damages). Zero for status-only changes.

plainFields.name: previous_quantity

plainFields.name: new_quantity
plainFields.description: Stock quantity after this movement for audit trail verification.

plainFields.name: reason

plainFields.name: reference_id
plainFields.description: External reference identifier for related entities. Contains order_id for order deductions, reservation_id for reservation movements, or other tracking identifiers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory movement occurred.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was created.
